item.title: Japón exige la rápida liberación de un ciudadano japonés detenido en Irán

item.title: Joel Embiid returns, teams with Tyrese Maxey to lead 76ers past Pacers
item.description: Joel Embiid had 27 points in his return to the lineup after missing five games, Tyrese Maxey scored 32 points, and the 76ers beat the Indiana Pacers 135-114 on Tuesday night.
